title: Vancouver T-shirt shipment leads to $5.8M cocaine seizure; police call it largest in force history
summary_full: In a shocking turn of events, workers in Vancouver stumbled upon 14 duffle bags filled with cocaine valued at C$5.8 million while unpacking a shipment of T-shirts on July 21. This illicit cargo was linked to organized crime in Honduras and had passed through Jamaica. Vancouver police are now investigating the shipping route to uncover the parties involved, urging anyone with information regarding the case to reach out.
